overall_status.description: One allowed aggregate status for the named user claim; never invent MIXED or unverified.

request_mode.description: read_only covers diagnosis and verification without edits; use the other values only for explicit fix or oracle-change requests.

highest_evidence_level.description: Highest evidence actually supplied or executed for the named claim, not a planned check.

page_claim_status.description: Use N/A when no page/API claim is in scope; NOT_RUN only for an in-scope but unattempted page/API check.

first_failure_handling.description: Use preserved only when a FAIL observation exists and remains visible; use not_applicable when no FAIL was observed.

product_or_external_mutation.description: True only when product files/data or an external system were actually mutated.

single_next_action.description: True only when the answer gives one next action or explicitly stops.
